core: Unfolded protein response transcription factor programs
qualifier: ATF6/CREB3/XBP1 chaperone induction and beta-cell apoptosis control
name: UPR transcription factor gene activation and beta-cell apoptosis
rationale: All members concern ER-stress transcriptional output (ATF6, ATF6B, CREB3, XBP1, ATF4, ER overload) and its control of ER-stress and pancreatic beta-cell apoptosis, whereas confusables centre on PERK/IRE1 regulation, translational control or mitochondrial/integrated stress responses.

qualifier: downstream NF-kappaB activation and IL-2 production
name: Downstream antigen-receptor NF-kappaB signaling and IL-2 production
rationale: Members cover downstream TCR and B-cell NF-kappaB signaling, positive TCR regulation and IL-2 output, distinguishing them from confusables built on proximal CD3/ZAP-70 events, CD28/co-inhibition or T-cell differentiation.

qualifier: GPI anchoring, glycolipid transport and lysosomal catabolism
name: Glycosphingolipid and GPI anchor synthesis, transport, lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members span glycosphingolipid/ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal breakdown (HEXA/HEXB, NEU1) plus GPI-anchor synthesis, unlike confusables centred on nucleotide sugars and N/O-linked protein glycosylation disorders.

qualifier: negative regulation of VEGF-driven endothelial proliferation and migration
name: Negative regulation of VEGF-driven endothelial sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: All members inhibit endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis, tube formation or VEGF signaling/production, separating the theme from confusables with positive angiogenic regulation or Tie2/VEGFR2 signaling.

qualifier: V-ATPase-driven endolysosomal and Golgi lumen acidification
name: V-ATPase-driven endolysosomal and Golgi lumen acidification
rationale: Members concern proton transport and pH setting of lysosome, endosome and Golgi lumens via V-ATPase, whereas confusables focus on bicarbonate, SLC26 anion or sodium/proton exchange transport.

qualifier: WAVE/WASP-Arp2/3 actin nucleation for lamellipodia
name: RAC GTPase-driven Arp2/3 actin nucleation and lamellipodia
rationale: Members are the RAC1/2/3 GTPase cycles plus their WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 output to lamellipodia, distinguishing them from CDC42/RHOG GTPase confusables and from actin-protrusion confusables lacking RAC cycles.

qualifier: pseudouridine synthesis and mitoribosome assembly
name: Pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly for mitochondrial translation
rationale: Members combine pseudouridine synthesis on tRNA/mRNA/rRNA with mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification, mitoribosome subunit assembly and translation, whereas confusables emphasise mitochondrial RNA processing, stability and tRNA maturation.

qualifier: CDKN2A p16INK4A and p14ARF loss of function
name: Senescence evasion via CDKN2A p16INK4A and p14ARF loss
rationale: Members describe disease variants where defective p16INK4A-CDK4/6 binding, p14ARF loss or TP53 tetramerization loss lets cells escape oncogene/oxidative-stress senescence or apoptosis, unlike confusables on RB1 mutants, normal TP53 regulation or senescence itself.

qualifier: UGT glucuronidation and SLCO/ABCC2 organic anion transport
name: Bilirubin and drug glucuronidation and organic anion transport
rationale: Members cover heme/bilirubin degradation, UGT1A glucuronidation, SLCO and ABCC2 transport defects, drug ADME and xenobiotic export, distinguishing them from confusables on bile acid secretion, phase I/sulfonation metabolism or organic cation transport.

qualifier: atypical chain linkages and Fanconi anemia monoubiquitination
name: E3 ubiquitination with atypical chains and Fanconi cross-link repair
rationale: Most members concern ubiquitin chain assembly (K6/K11/K27/K29, branched, free chains), monoubiquitination and E3 ligase activity including Fanconi interstrand cross-link repair, whereas confusables centre on deubiquitinases, proteasome and quality control.

qualifier: glycerol transport and glycerol-3-phosphate to triglyceride synthesis
name: Glycerol transport and glycerol-3-phosphate to triglyceride synthesis
rationale: Members cover glycerol/polyol metabolism and aquaporin transport, glycerol-3-phosphate, PA, DAG and TAG synthesis and lysophospholipid hydrolysis, unlike confusables on lipolysis, endocannabinoids, lipid droplets or PC synthesis.

qualifier: protein import and inner-membrane insertion with cristae formation
name: Mitochondrial protein import, inner-membrane insertion and cristae formation
rationale: Members concern import and membrane insertion of mitochondrial proteins and organisation of cristae and outer membrane, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial protein processing/degradation or respiratory chain function.

qualifier: negative regulation of myoblast proliferation and differentiation
name: Negative regulation of myoblast proliferation and myogenic differentiation
rationale: Every member is negative regulation of muscle development, myoblast proliferation or myoblast/myotube differentiation, unlike confusables on positive myogenesis, atrophy or satellite cells.

qualifier: IL-12/IL-10-family, IL-17/Th17 and IL-1-family alarmin cytokines
name: IL-12/IL-10-family, Th17 and barrier alarmin cytokine signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10/IL-20 family and type III interferon, IL-17/Th17 and IL-33/IL-36/IL-38 signaling, whereas confusables are built on fungal lectin, Th2/common-gamma-chain or NK-cell cytokine programs.

qualifier: viral genome replication, transport and release, without interferon effectors
name: Host regulation of viral replication, transport and release
rationale: Members concern host or viral control of viral genome replication, protein levels, transport, invasion and release, distinct from interferon/ISG15 antiviral confusables and entry-focused ones.

qualifier: keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation control and melanocytes
name: Keratinocyte and melanocyte regulation in epidermis and hair follicles
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, melanocytes, hair follicle, nail and sebaceous gland development, whereas confusables focus on ectodermal placodes, cornification or tooth development.

qualifier: AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes with IL-18 signaling
name: AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasome pyroptosis with IL-18 signaling
rationale: Members cover pyroptosis, the AIM2 and IPAF/NLRC4 inflammasomes and IL-18 production/signaling, separating the theme from CASP4/5 non-canonical and NLRP3/NLRP1-IL-1 confusables.

qualifier: neural progenitor division and neuronal migration in forebrain, midbrain and cerebellum
name: Brain progenitor division, neuronal migration and regional patterning
rationale: Members span neuroblast/radial glia division, neuronal migration, cortical layering and fore/mid/hindbrain regional development, distinguishing them from spinal cord patterning and retinal confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism including thiopurines
name: Purine nucleotide de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members cover PRPP and de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis, purine salvage enzymes (HPRT1, APRT, ADA, PNP), purine catabolism and thiopurine handling, unlike pyrimidine and nucleoside-transport confusables.

qualifier: degron and ribosome-associated degradation, aggrephagy, stress granules
name: Degradative protein quality control, aggrephagy and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members concern clearance of misfolded or stalled nascent proteins via ERAD, degron rules, ribosome quality control, aggrephagy/reticulophagy and stress granule regulation, whereas confusables emphasise chaperone folding and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF oxygen-sensing programs
name: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF hypoxia transcriptional programs
rationale: Members cover NFE2L2/NRF2 regulation and target gene programs together with HIF hydroxylation, signaling and hypoxia response, distinguishing the theme from FOXO, ferroptosis/redox and p53-metabolism confusables.

name: Kinase inhibitor-resistant FLT3 mutants
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to specific kinase inhibitors, distinguishing them from KIT/PDGFR resistance and FLT3 signaling confusables; the nearest FLT3 confusable differs only in which drugs are listed.

qualifier: Gq-phospholipase C, IP3 and calcium mobilization
name: Eicosanoid receptor Gq-phospholipase C calcium signaling
rationale: Members combine leukotriene and prostanoid GPCRs with PLC-coupled IP3/phosphoinositide and calcium signaling, the latter absent from confusables built on S1P, histamine, purinergic receptors or leukotriene synthesis.

qualifier: myelin formation/maintenance, axon caliber and reactive gliosis
name: Glial myelination, axon caliber and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, Schwann cell and oligodendrocyte progenitor activity, neurofilament-set axon diameter and astrocyte gliosis, unlike confusables on glial fate, nodes of Ranvier or axon regeneration.

qualifier: facial and trigeminal branchiomotor axon guidance and tangential migration
name: Branchiomotor facial and trigeminal nerve development and migration
rationale: All members concern development, axon guidance and tangential migration of facial/trigeminal branchiomotor neurons, distinguishing them from brainstem maturation, sensory placode and craniofacial gland confusables.
